questions.stem: In dollars, what tolerance does the golden comparison put on the stored objective?

options.says: 0.01 is the tolerance in $k, the objective's unit: $10, not a cent.
The stated tolerance is 0.01 $k, $10; $1 would be 0.001 $k.
Right: 0.01 $k, far above solver noise near 1e-5, far below one project.

origin.section: Compare Field by Field, Within Tolerances Stated in Business Units

questions.stem: regressions.py compared the two broken precedence rows with the four golden scenarios. What did it print?

options.text: Lag ignored: tiny and small failed. Lag plus one: small failed.
options.says: Tiny passed with the lag ignored, and the lag plus one passed everywhere.

options.text: Lag ignored: small failed. Lag plus one: small failed as well.
options.says: The lag plus one passed all four scenarios.

options.text: Lag ignored: all four failed. Lag plus one: all four passed.
options.says: With the lag ignored only small failed.

options.text: Lag ignored: small failed. Lag plus one: all four passed.
options.says: Right: the too-strict row changed none of the four answers.

origin.section: A Golden Test Catches Regressions, Not Rule Errors
